name: MeshCore
description: MeshCore companion firmware (github.com/meshcore-dev/MeshCore, tag companion-v1.18.0, commit 81dbae5) hosted inside another firmware: the mesh core, the chat mesh and the companion app protocol, with the radio, clock, storage and app links supplied by the host through src/MeshCoreHost.h. Upstream files are unchanged except where marked MESHCORE_HOSTED.
